basic_info.description: 338 Marietta Drive is a charming three-bedroom, three-bath mid-century home tucked away on a peaceful, tree-lined block in Miraloma Park. Lovingly maintained by the same family for over 60 years, this residence exudes both character and comfort.  The open concept living and dining room features a wood-burning fireplace and a dramatic wall of windows that frame the leafy outlook and views of Twin Peaks. With three bedrooms and two baths on this floor, the spacious en-suite primary bedroom overlooks the serene garden, and both bathrooms have skylights bringing in natural light. The eat-in kitchen flows seamlessly to the private patio, lush south-facing yard, and terraced garden. Mature plantings, including maple trees, rose bushes, daffodils and tulips create a tranquil retreat and offer beauty every season.  The lower level features a separate entrance, flex room, bath, laundry room, plentiful storage, and a two-car garage.  Located near Glen Canyon Park, Mount Davidson's scenic trails, and Portola shops. Easy access to 280 and 101.  With its coveted, functional floor plan and verdant private yard, this incredible home offers a canvas for its new owner's vision.
